Method of Attack: Exploitation of CVE-2021-44228 (Log4Shell) to run a base64-encoded PowerShell payload
Downloading and executing a modular PowerShell backdoor
System enumeration, C2 communications, receiving, decrypting, and loading additional modules
Modules include application enumeration, screenshot capture and upload, process listing, system information gathering, remote command execution, and cleanup
Indicators of Compromise: HTTP POST requests to google.com with parameter hi=hi
Use of hardcoded FTP credentials for screenshot uploads
Presence of Ni.txt file in $APPDATA path
